messages:
Lena: quick heads-up found inconsistent terminology across quickstarts and SDK snippets: `prompt`, `instruction`, `input`, `user_text`. Users hit this in onboarding. Thinking we should standardize and add automation to catch old forms.
Omar: agreed. Proposal: canonical param `user_input`. Keeps it generic for chat, generation, embeddings.
Priya: +1 for `user_input`. Also recommend a short section in the style guide that explains when to use 'instruction' vs 'prompt' vs 'user_input' in prose (not API).
Cal: tiny nit  some of our examples currently depend on a JS SDK variant that still accepts `prompt` (backwards-compat). We should plan a deprecation timeline and a compatibility shim in code samples: show both names for one release.
Lena: good call. Plan: 1) update canonical snippets to `user_input`; 2) add migration note and deprecation banner; 3) add a linter/snippet-test to CI to flag `prompt_text`/`prompt`/`input`; 4) run repo-wide grep and create PRs for obvious matches.
Omar: for the linter, we can add a docs-mdcheck rule that errors on deprecated param names. I can prototype a rule and add it to snippet-tests.
Priya: I'll write the style blurb. Draft: "user_input the raw text supplied by an end user. Use 'instruction' when the text is an imperative directive for instruct-tuned models; use 'prompt' colloquially in quickstarts but prefer 'user_input' in API docs." Short and prescriptive.
Cal: CI-wise, DocsBot can run the grep and open branch PRs. DocsBot: want me to run that scan now? :robot_face:
DocsBot: queued: run grep for 'prompt_text|\bprompt\b|\binput\b' in sources/**, generate report, open topic branches for matches. Will post results.
Lena: please scope grep to code snippets only (docs code fences + examples folders) to avoid false positives in prose.
DocsBot: adjusted. Running scan on /docs/examples, /docs/snippets, /README.md files.
Omar: also include a small migration snippet for JS and Python and show both old and new forms. Example to add to migration guide:
```js
// old
client.generate({ prompt: 'Translate to French: Hello' })
// new
client.generate({ user_input: 'Translate to French: Hello' })
```
```py
# old
client.generate(prompt_text='Translate to French: Hello')
# new
client.generate(user_input='Translate to French: Hello')
```
Lena: action items: Priya draft style blurb + migration paragraph; Omar prototype docs-mdcheck rule + run linter; Cal coordinate snippet PRs and compatibility notes; DocsBot run scan and open branches. I'll create a short changelog entry after merges and ping PMs for release notes wording.
Priya: will add the glossary entry too and link it from quickstarts.
Cal: we should also add a one-release UI hint: keep label 'Prompt' but show tiny help text "API param: user_input (was prompt)" so Console users aren't surprised.
Lena: agreed. We'll keep that in the UI backlog item. I'll follow up with a small ticket. :thumbsup:
